rows.note: Use this for ordinary crumbs from bread or other baked food, especially when the food is bread.

example.english: After eating toast, there is still a crumb on the table.
example.traditional: 食完多士，枱面仲有一粒麵包碎。
example.jyutping: sik6 jyun4 do1 si2 ci4 min6 zung6 jau5 jat1 nap1 min6 baau1 seoi3

rows.note: Use this for loose crumbs of cake or biscuits, or for tiny fragments of other solid materials when a food-specific term is not being used.

example.english: After eating a biscuit, I had a crumb stuck to my shirt.
example.traditional: 食完曲奇，我件衫黐咗一粒碎屑。
example.jyutping: sik6 jyun4 kuk1 kei4 ngo5 gin6 saam1 ci1 zo2 jat1 nap1 seoi3 sit3

rows.note: Use this for a very small amount of something abstract or uncountable, such as comfort.

example.english: This news did not give me a crumb of comfort.
example.traditional: 呢個消息連一丁點安慰都冇畀我。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 siu1 sik1 lin4 jat1 ding1 dim2 on1 wai3 dou1 mou5 bei2 ngo5
